claims.claim_text: Gustave M Christianson has a high-confidence identifier-backed Army record match.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier and surname-middle-initial combination match an Army entry dated 8 September 1943; the entry spells the given name Gustav rather than the index's Gustave.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact private identifier, surname and middle initial with only the documented Gustav/Gustave spelling difference; assessed high confidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry date establishes a wartime observation but not the date or route of later OSS service.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is masked publicly. Gustav M Christianson is retained as a documented source spelling, not a correction to the index.

claims.claim_text: The Army entry records the occupational group ‘Occupations in printing and publishing, n.e.c.’
claims.evidence_excerpt: Occupations in printing and publishing, n.e.c.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The identifier-backed Army record carries occupation code 449, which the inspected NARA code page labels Occupations in printing and publishing, n.e.c.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact private identifier, surname and middle initial with a documented Gustav/Gustave spelling difference; assessed high confidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: Observed with an Army entry date of 8 September 1943; temporal relationship to OSS entry remains uncertain.
claims.match_notes: No named employer, workplace, specific job title or employment date is inferred from the occupational group.

claims.claim_text: Christian C Christis has an unresolved service-identifier/name conflict.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact private identifier returns an Army entry naming Christ G Christis rather than Christian C Christis.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The identifier agrees, but both the given-name form and middle initial conflict. The Army occupation cannot be assigned to the indexed person without further evidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflicting Army entry is dated 12 October 1942; no occupation or recruitment chronology is accepted from it.
claims.match_notes: The printed index row remains unchanged and the full identifier remains private. Box 123 review is required.

claims.claim_text: Richard A Christman has a high-confidence identifier-backed Army record match.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier and exact indexed name match an Army entry dated 12 May 1943 whose grade field reads private.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact indexed name plus exact private identifier; assessed high confidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry predates the index's T-5 rank observation but does not establish the date or route of OSS service.
claims.match_notes: The index's T-5 rank is preserved unchanged; the earlier Army entry grade is not substituted for it. The private identifier is masked publicly.

claims.claim_text: The Army entry records the occupational group ‘Occupations in production of bakery products, n.e.c.’
claims.evidence_excerpt: Occupations in production of bakery products, n.e.c.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The identifier-backed Army record carries occupation code 802, which the inspected NARA code page labels Occupations in production of bakery products, n.e.c.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact indexed name plus exact private identifier; assessed high confidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: Observed with an Army entry date of 12 May 1943; temporal relationship to OSS entry remains uncertain.
claims.match_notes: No named employer, workplace, bakery, specific job title or employment date is inferred from the occupational group.

claims.claim_text: Peter A Christoff has an unresolved service-identifier/name conflict.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact private identifier returns an Army entry naming Peter K Christoff rather than Peter A Christoff.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The identifier and full first and last names agree, but the middle initial conflicts. The Army occupation cannot be assigned to the indexed person without further evidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflicting Army entry is dated 29 June 1943; no occupation or recruitment chronology is accepted from it.
claims.match_notes: The printed index row remains unchanged and the full identifier remains private. Box 123 review is required.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact private identifier is absent from the complete Army file. One exact-name Army row carries another identifier, while modern dentist and other namesakes lack an OSS or Box 123 bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 123 for identifiers that distinguish Roy P Christian from the Army and modern namesakes and establish his pre-OSS history.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Neither the exact private identifier nor an exact Waldemar C Christian name appears in the complete Army file, and accessible official, obituary, institutional and newspaper searches did not establish an identity bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 123 to identify Waldemar C Christian and establish his service context and pre-OSS affiliation.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies no private identifier. Multiple William B Christian Army rows, including junior variants, cannot be selected by a common name alone, and external searches provided no Box 123 bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 123 for a service number, birth year or hometown that can distinguish William B Christian and establish his pre-OSS pathway.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies no private identifier. One Army row names William Christians without a middle initial, but no second identifier or direct OSS connection establishes that it belongs to this person.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 123 for a service number, birth year or hometown that can test the William Christians Army candidate and establish pre-OSS history.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The six-digit index value was preserved exactly and not padded. One exact-name Army row carries a different eight-digit identifier, and no external source bridges it to Box 123.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 123 to determine the meaning of Herbert P Christiansen's six-digit value and establish his identity and pre-OSS pathway.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact private identifier, surname and middle initial match an official Army entry dated 8 September 1943; the Army source spells the given name Gustav rather than the index's Gustave, and the occupation code is supported by the inspected NARA code page.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 123 for Gustave M Christianson's named employer, work dates and route from printing or publishing work into Army and OSS service.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact private identifier matches an Army row naming Christ G Christis, not Christian C Christis. Both the given-name form and middle initial conflict, so no Army occupation is assigned.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 123 and the original Army record to resolve the Christian C versus Christ G name conflict before assigning any occupation or affiliation.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact indexed name and private identifier match an official Army entry dated 12 May 1943; the entry-grade field reads private and the occupation code is supported by the inspected NARA code page.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 123 for Richard A Christman's named employer, work dates, progression from the Army entry grade to the indexed T-5 rank and route into OSS.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies no private identifier, no exact William D Christman row appears in the complete Army file, and burial, obituary and directory namesakes lack an OSS or Box 123 bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 123 for a service number, birth year or hometown that can identify William D Christman and establish his pre-OSS history.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact private identifier matches an Army row naming Peter K Christoff, not Peter A Christoff. The middle initial conflict prevents assignment of the Army occupation.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 123 and the original Army record to resolve the Peter A versus Peter K middle-initial conflict before assigning any occupation or affiliation.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 80 context and complete Army bulk comparison; exact-name and private-identifier OSS/CIA searches; employment, occupation, obituary, institutional, Library of Congress newspaper and archival-source searches for Roy P Christian.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The exact identifier is absent from the Army file; an exact-name Army row carries another identifier, while modern dentist and government-payment namesakes are too recent and lack an OSS bridge.
research_attempts.research_notes: Bounded individual adjudication, not proof that no prior employer existed. No raw Army row, full private identifier or authenticated Catalog payload is retained.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 123 for identifying and pre-OSS evidence.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 80 context and complete Army bulk comparison; exact-name and private-identifier OSS/CIA searches; employment, occupation, obituary, institutional, Library of Congress newspaper and archival-source searches for Waldemar C Christian.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Neither the identifier nor exact name appears in the Army file, and broad newspaper and institutional hits concern unrelated uses of Waldemar or Christian.
research_attempts.research_notes: Bounded individual adjudication; missing merged-file coverage is not proof against service or employment.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 123 for identifying and pre-OSS evidence.
